snippet.title: Scallywags Gameplay Teaser 1
snippet.description:
We are making a pirate friendslop game!
Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5224400/Scallywags/

-fun ragdoll combat and movement
-fight with friends and enemies
-different melee weapons and guns
-crazy levels
-slow mo!
-epic unserious pirate action!
